sn43.5:1.1: From here through to [sn43.11]() we find the seven sets of practices later renowned as the 37 “qualities on the side of awakening” (_bodhipakkhiyadhammā_). These are repeated with more details at [sn43.12](). These also form the main topics of the Mahāvagga of the Saṁyutta, to which I give references.
